name: Resistance temperature detector
summary: An RTD is a temperature sensor whose resistance changes with temperature.
description: An RTD is a temperature sensor whose resistance changes with temperature. Its schematic needs the selected sensor characteristic and two-, three- or four-wire measurement connection.
readingNotes: Count sensor conductors at the measuring input instead of inferring them from the sensor name.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: An RTD is different from a discrete temperature switch or a thermocouple voltage source.
